description: Purchase a managed number. Requires explicit user approval (confirm=true) and a stable idempotency_key. May incur recurring charges; regulatory or billing setup may require Console.

agent_id.description: Optional agent to route inbound calls to.

phone_number.description: A US, Canada, or India number (E.164) from the available-numbers search.

provisioning_mode.description: Use `adopt_preowned` only for a number already ordered through assisted provisioning. It never buys a number.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user authorizes this exact purchase or destination.

idempotency_key.description: Required safe retry key. Reusing the key with an identical body replays the original 201 response (no second number purchase); reusing it with a different body returns 409 `idempotency_conflict`.
